issues.issue: Did the RAD err in refusing to admit the six bus receipts as new evidence?
issues.applicant_position: Receipts show mother-in-law travels to Port Harcourt, so it is not viable; receipts should be admitted.
issues.result_text: RAD properly rejected receipts: they predated the RPD hearing and were unexplained.

issues.issue: Did the RAD breach procedural fairness by not advising the applicants of its credibility concerns?
issues.result_text: Credibility comments were obiter; failure to advise on credibility was immaterial.

issues.issue: Did the RAD reasonably find no significant barriers to establishing in Port Harcourt (viable IFA)?
issues.applicant_position: Port Harcourt is not viable because the mother-in-law travels there.
issues.result_text: Reasonable for RAD to find no significant barriers to relocating in Port Harcourt.
